name: Zack
source:
Zack was born in Brookdale on March 11th, 2009. He joined the police academy as soon as he finished high school, and graduated from there with top honors. He is now one of the most famous detectives in the East Coast of the United States. He enjoys spending most of his time watching movies, with dreams of eventually writing his own.
